snippet.title: PlayStation - Bokujou Monogatari Harvest Moon for Girl (2000)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Bokujou Monogatari Harvest Moon for Girl is a Strategy game, developed by TOSE and published by Victor Interactive Software, which was released in Japan in 2000.
